s.g: (loosely, attributively) Something extending across the RGB color space; (especially) something having a wide variety of vivid colors.
(by extension, slang) RGB lighting; lights (especially LEDs) able to display a wide range of colors by being able to individually adjust the strength of the red, green, and blue channels.

rgb.f: Initialism of red, green, blue; an additive color model in which colors are represented by adding varying amounts of red, green, and blue light.

rgba.f: (computer graphics) Initialism of red, green, blue, alpha.

rgg.f: (rhythmic gymnastics) Initialism of rhythmic gymnastics groups.

rgi.f: (rhythmic gymnastics) Initialism of rhythmic gymnastics individuals.
